propositions: rebar must support S3 buckets with SSE-KMS encryption as the ticket-store remote via git-remote-s3 helper, maintaining identical git/event data format and auto-commit/push flow

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and the git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below the pinned minimum version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message instead of risking multi-bundle corruption

multiple concurrent or legacy pushes to the same S3 bucket ref can leave two separate bundle files for one SHA, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at two SHAs and fresh clones to hard-fail; this state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads under a repair lock while preserving all commits from all branches

operators must be able to enable and configure the S3 backend from documentation alone, including optional dependency installation, helper version requirements, SSE-KMS bucket and CMK/IAM setup, and sync.remote configuration
